signal: Cloudpermit acquired CityReporter in Feb 2026, expanding its local-government software suite into maintenance, inspections, and asset management

email.body1:
Brad, saw Cloudpermit acquired CityReporter and expanded the suite into maintenance and asset management.

A broader municipal product usually opens more in-market government accounts than a region can cover before they cool, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for your region off Cloudpermit's hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Brad, quick follow-up on your region at Cloudpermit.

With CityReporter's products to cross-sell, the regional pipeline target climbs faster than reps can ramp. Most teams cannot say how many municipal meetings they need to book to hit it, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Brad, last bit of proof for your team at Cloudpermit.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Cloudpermit's reply rate likely compares to other govtech vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Brad, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling regional pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters most right after an acquisition, and I know cross-selling a new suite to municipalities is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your region? I will tailor it to Cloudpermit either way.
